subject: Important Update: Your Account Security
body: Dear valued customer, We are writing to inform you about recent security enhancements to our online platform. Your account security is our top priority, and we have implemented additional measures to protect your personal information. Please review your account settings and ensure your password is strong and unique. If you have any concerns or questions, feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for trusting us with your financial security. Best regards, The Security Team
